name: replace_domain_dns_records
description:
Replace the DNS records for a domain using a BIND zone file supplied in requestBody. Overwrites existing records and can disrupt domain routing or verification.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel --scope {teamSlugOrId} dns import {domain} {zoneFilePath}. Fill placeholders from inputs.

requestBody.description: DNS records in BIND zone-file format.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
